objective: Define the explicit canonical baseline and approval boundary that must be satisfied before one authorized live recompute writeback may mutate canonical surfaces, using the completed dry-run inspection result as the immediate upstream prerequisite.

phase_plan.requirement: Require the live-writeback contract to remain dry-run-ready and explicitly live-guarded
Require the dry-run execution inspection checkpoint to confirm non-canonical output materialization while canonical surfaces remain pending
Require the canonical post-plan recompute monitoring path to still read as pending completion before live execution
All canonical recompute surfaces must still have pending latest triggers and no computed outputs before live writeback
The canonical baseline snapshot tool must be present to capture the live pre-writeback baseline immediately before execution
Live execution must require execution-mode live-writeback plus explicit allow-live-writeback opt-in
Approval is bounded to one canonical live writeback followed immediately by recompute observation, post-recompute observation, and post-plan monitoring reruns
Authority mirrors may register the live baseline and approval checkpoint without claiming canonical completion before execution occurs
The next action must be exactly one authorized live writeback followed by the downstream observation chain rerun

approval_contract.approval_non_claim_boundary: Approval defines execution permission only and does not itself claim canonical recompute completion.

non_claim_boundary: Repository-local live-writeback baseline and approval contract only; no scientific adequacy claim and no implied canonical recompute completion.
